title: Ono-ha Itto Ryu - Bukijutsu Sword Style
body:
Syntax: SWORDSTYLE Ono-ha Itto Ryu | SWORDSTYLE LIST | SWORDSTYLE OFF

Ono-ha Itto Ryu unlocks for Bukijutsu at level 215 and is learned automatically at that level. Decisive centerline cuts with powerful single-strike force. Wield one sword to use it.

At 100% mastery: +8 accuracy and +28% sword damage. Each landed strike costs 6 Stamina. Bonuses increase with mastery, starting at a partial strength. Use PRAC <school name> with a teacher for your initial lesson and improve it by landing ordinary sword attacks while selected. Only one sword school may be active at a time; its selection persists across logins. See HELP SWORDSTYLE for the full list.
